title: Comms Window
caption: Forty minutes before the last relay goes behind Saturn.

captions.text: The tanker Ladoga is passing Saturn. The red dot by the rings is the last relay.
Forty minutes, and it goes behind the planet. After that, a year of silence all the way to Earth.
Vera holds her mug in both hands. The tea went cold long ago, but it's warmer this way.
